purpose: Teach: ひっかかっ/手ごろ/めでたし/微塵/多けれ/ともども/気長/なめらか

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の予定にひっかかってお店が混んだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the shop got busier because of the customer schedule changes, didn't it?
lines.style: Soft observation, slightly wondering. Warm but measured pace. The tone of noticing something together, not accusingly. Trails gently into the question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューは手ごろな価格で出しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's why we should price the new menu items reasonably.
lines.style: Practical conviction, clear and direct without being harsh. Speaking from experience. Slight emphasis on 'reasonably' — it matters. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、めでたし顔でお見えになったわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers have been looking so happy when they come in lately, haven't they?
lines.style: Pleased warmth, noticing detail. A small smile in the voice. Gentle emphasis on 'happy' — it delights her. Unhurried, conversational.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、私達のお店、微塵も諦めないで頑張ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's not give up on this place, not even a little. We'll keep pushing forward together.
lines.style: Gentle resolve underneath. Not a rallying cry — quieter, more intimate. Steady tone, warm but firm. The voice of someone who means it because she's thought about it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が多ければ多いほど忙しいけど嬉しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The busier it gets with customers, the harder the work is, but it makes me happy.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Light, unhurried. A small laugh underneath — she means this fully. Slight rise on 'happy' — it catches her a little. Soft fadeout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お得意様ともども成長していきましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's grow together — you, me, and our regular customers.
lines.style: Tender but grounded. Slow, deliberate pace. The warmth of including someone. Emphasis lands on 'together' — it's the point. Closing with quiet care.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の好みは気長に把握しましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should learn what our customers like — no rush, just patience.
lines.style: Patient guidance, not instructing. Thoughtful pace, like working through something meaningful. Slight emphasis on 'patience' — it's the virtue here. Trailing but present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューはなめらかな食感がいいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The texture of the new menu items is really smooth — that's good.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, almost tactile in tone. Close, intimate delivery like she's sharing a small discovery. Warmth on 'smooth.' Quiet satisfaction at the end.
